name: Eva Tsunaka
source:
In a killing game, you need to be able to trust those around you. But with the Ultimate Liar, is trust even possible? Eva has made it clear that she doesn't intend to lie to anyone, but how can anyone believe any promises she makes? Truly a quiet and mysterious figure, she often stares into the distance and makes you feel like anything you say to her is being completely ignored, as if she is lost in her own world of thought.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/ProjEdensGarden/status/1349067071368392704]official source[/url]]
